<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Budget planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline objectives for the upcoming period"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and justifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review strategic alignment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StrategicFeedback" name="Are adjustments needed after strategic review?" default="Flow_StrategicNoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Review budget feasibility"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinanceFeedback" name="Are adjustments needed after finance review?" default="Flow_FinanceNoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Obtain stakeholder approval for adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Begin implementing plan"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Budget distributed and implementation begins"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_Strategic" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Strategic_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Gateway_StrategicFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicAdjustment" name="Adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_StrategicFeedback" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentsRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicNoAdjustment" name="No adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_StrategicFeedback" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finance_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_FinanceFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceAdjustment" name="Adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_FinanceFeedback" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentsRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceNoAdjustment" name="No adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_FinanceFeedback" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveAdjustment_Strategic" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
